# Historical mainnet script evidence: v0-upgrade

Point-in-time public RPC observations retained for deterministic script, identity, upgrade and consistency tests. They are not fresh custody observations or an operator deployment manifest. Original JSON/executable bytes are unchanged. Current procedures and test scope are in [validation](../../../../docs/validation.md).

Reproduce checksum verification from this directory with `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS` when a manifest exists. Fixture checksums establish file integrity, not current liveness or consensus authentication.
